steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Convincing Leone to sell his shares? Not happening. Count me out.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Why? Aren't you two friends?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Sure, but we wouldn't be if I forced him to do stuff like that. We've all tried talking to him about the shares, but the stubborn bastard won't listen.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is there really no way to get through to him?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ugh... And here I was thinking that if only you'd talk to him for me, then...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Then what?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Th-Then, I'd give you this box of chocolates as a thank-you...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Chocolates, huh.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The patisserie back home gave me these when I set out. Said I'd have something to chew on whenever my mouth was empty. And now, this is the last box...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I, um... I'm really, really reluctant to give this away. So, since you don't want to, forget it...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: (*whispers*) Did he just respond with a grunt? That's different—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If you don't want to help, then, um, no chocolate for you. Err, that came out wrong...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Okay, I confess, it was Helena who suggested I bring you chocolates. She said that you have a soft spot for them.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: So she told you to come, and here you are?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Leone's situation is looking really bad... I have to try everything I can, no matter what it takes.
Woodrow stares straight at Jessica, but she doesn't notice.
She's completely lost in her embarrassment and frustration. Her head droops as she furiously racks her brain to figure out how to navigate this conversation faster.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry to keep pestering you. I'll head back for now, and think of some other way myself...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Just leave the chocolates on the cabinet.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Gimme a moment to pack up and wash my face. Then we're leaving.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...He's agreeing to it? Even though I totally blew my secret?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Does he care about his image with Helena that much...? Or is it the chocolates? Well, whatever, all that matters is that he agreed.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The cabinet, the cabinet... Oh, is it this one?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...The drawer's open?
The objects in the old Sankta's drawer resemble him—simple and unadorned.
A belt, a holster, and a pair of fingerless gloves.
Jessica sets the box of chocolates down, and notices a few pieces of paper pressed beneath the gloves.
Eroded by time, the pages have taken on a brittle, yellow complexion.
Jessica knows that she shouldn't look, but can't control her urges to sneak a peek.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is this... a photo of Woodrow and the boss? There's another Sankta, too... and a piece of paper under the photo...
It is an identification document. The black ink is hard to make out on the brown parchment, and only a few words readily stand out.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Camp... Collus...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You done putting away the chocolates?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh, uh, y-yes! By the way, I...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Then let's get going.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Leone, your financial situation is in dire straits. If you drag your feet any longer, then...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: When the bank declares you unable to repay your debts, you'll be forced to declare bankruptcy. And by that point, you won't be able to save your shares or your house.

spans.text: When the bank declares you unable to repay your debts, you'll be forced to declare bankruptcy. And by that point, you won't be able to save your shares

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If you insist on holding onto your shares, you'll be forced to sell off your house, and won't even have a roof over your head.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Plenty of people have tried to talk me into selling my shares, but you're the first to make a good case for selling my house.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No, I'm not telling you to sell your house. I'm just reminding you of the consequences.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If you don't mind, I can also, umm... What I mean is, I have some money I can give you to help pay off your loans. Even though it's no small amount...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What?! Thanks, but no thanks. I don't need your charity.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: N-N-No! I mean, I'll lend it to you!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: B-But, I won't charge any interest. You can just pay it back at your leisure, whenever your financial situation has improved...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Look, Jessica. I'm a grown ass man with both my hands and feet. I don't need a little girl half my age lecturing me on how to improve my life.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I hope you never bring this up to me again.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wait... Leone, p-please, don't push me!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What, you're out here sipping tea, Woodrow? It's already gone cold. Just take the girl with you when you go.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Aren't you going to say something, Woodrow? You agreed to this...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Did I?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: All I said was that I'd come with you. So I did.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Thanks for the chocolate, Jessica. Now, if you'll excuse me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You can't do this!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: At this rate, Leone's going to be left with nothing to his name!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: So what? Try as you like, when you burn a wet piece of coal all you get is a faceful of ashes.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How could you?! You...!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Captain, are we seriously going to go through the entire list?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: How many doors have we knocked on so far?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Fourteen. Other than the second household, where the middle-aged man's son did in fact run off to join the bandits, the rest were all honest people guilty of nothing more than being unable to pay off their debts.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The bank couldn't dig up any dirt on them, so they've resorted to using us to run them out of town... Despicable.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...And this is number fifteen. We'll check just one more, and then—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Wait, what's going on? Why are you sitting outside?

steps.name: Dizzy Old Man
steps.text: My head... it's spinning...

steps.name: Impoverished Old Lady
steps.text: Hmph. Go sit outside in the cold, you crusty old fossil. The headache will go away on its own.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Could he have been poisoned?

steps.name: Impoverished Old Lady
steps.text: Lucky we found out in time, and we're both just fine.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Ma'am, I thought the plate... it should have retained its basic heating functions. So why...?

steps.name: Impoverished Old Lady
steps.text: After the bank declared us bankrupt, they shut off all the heating to our house. Without sunlight, it gets even colder inside.

steps.name: Impoverished Old Lady
steps.text: ...Why else would anyone light their fireplace?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I'm back, Benny. What're you squatting in front of the stove for? Get up already.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: The charcoal today is especially waterlogged. I've been trying to light it for a while now, but I can't get it burning at all.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Just look at all the soot on your face. You'd think you just crawled out of the mines... Hurry and wipe it off. It ain't a big deal if you can't get it burning. Just wait until I get back.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Dad, don't tell me you were in such a hurry this morning that you poured water directly into the stove...?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hey, I may be stupid, but I'm not that stupid. Hand me the tongs. I'll do it.

spans.text: Hey, I may be stupid, but I'm not
stupid. Hand me the tongs. I'll do it.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: You think I can't tell when you're lost in the sauce? Why are you blowing on it directly? Carl told me you can't light the stove, which is why he entrusted it to me before he left. Since when have you done it?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: What else did Carl tell you?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Everything. About how you were so impatient you poured an entire pail of water into the stove to douse the flames. Not only did the coal get ruined, but the bread Helena baked became inedible. She was so mad she chewed your ear off.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: When did he tell you all that?!

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Who do you think left me all alone back then?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hmph. Left you on all alone? What're you talking about? How would you even remember anything from when you were so little? All you did was sit in Woodrow's arms and tug on his beard.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: ...I don't believe you.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*! Who is it?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sorry, it's me— *cough*, urgh, all this smoke...

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: The stove's completely soaked on the inside. I've been trying to ignite the charcoal for a while now, but haven't had much luck. Give me a moment.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No problem. I can help out too.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: These pieces of charcoal are completely waterlogged. Can you swap them out?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: This is all the charcoal we got from the caravan.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Then, um... how about some firewood?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: We can put the broken pieces underneath to isolate the moisture, then lean any thin branches against the stove to light them on fire. Then you just need to add more firewood as necessary.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Where'd you learn all that... On the battlefield?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Why do you ask?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Aren't you a mercenary?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: It's done...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Thanks for helping Benny light the stove, but... you should leave now.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But I haven't even said anything yet... I just don't understand. Why are you so stubborn about it?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Of course you wouldn't.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Then... help me understand? I'll never give up if you just keep sending me away.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Jessica... I was abandoned here by my birth mother when I was just four years old. It was the miners here who raised me.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: When I enlisted in the army, I focused on learning blasting techniques so that I'd be able to help out in the mines. As soon as I was discharged, I came back and became an mining engineer.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I was involved in the renovation and expansion of the mining tunnels below town, the factory above us, and even the power plant we repaired a few days ago.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The miners back then... must've lived much better lives than they do now.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: If you told me back then what Davistown would become, I'd have figured you were cursing me out.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: True... Life can be unpredictable like that.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Later, I adopted my coworker's kids. Benny... and his brother, Carl.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: And even later... the mine kept depreciating until all I could do was keep holding onto my shares no matter what. Like hell I'd let those damn stakeholders take my life's work and dump it for scraps.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But there's no way the mine is ever coming back—

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Just stop talking.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm serious here! If you keep holding onto your shares, the bank is going to force you to pay off your debts!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ...Get out of my house.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Please, Leone. Even if you kick me out, you're going to have to come face-to-face with reality.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Alright, Benny, step out for a bit. You can stay at Auntie Helena's for a night. I'll come find you after Jessica and I finish talking.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: —Wait, you can't send Benny away!

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Now you're trying to lecture me on how to be a parent?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yesterday...

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Just stop it already, Jessica! Not another word!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yesterday... Some gangsters hired by the bank went after your son.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Is that true, Benny?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: ...Yes.
Leone's heart constricts as he looks at Benny's soot-stained face.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Why... Why didn't you tell me anything...?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Even if I did... what good would it do? Would you march up to the bank and make a scene? What would that even solve...?
After seeing his child leave, the man who had been talking so confidently a moment ago immediately hunches his back and squats down by the stove.
He picks up the tongs and carefully prods at the wood.
Even though the flame is already burning brightly, a puff of black smoke still comes out and sends him into a fit of coughing.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: If I sell my shares in the mine, what'll I have left?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: At they very least... You won't leave Benny saddled with debt, and they won't take your house.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: First, it was Carl. After Carl left, it was Benny... Ever since I took on so much debt, I've been out working from sunup to sundown, leaving the kids at home to fend for themselves...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: They were in charge of keeping the stove lit, and they had to handle the finances. And Benny... was nearly kidnapped...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: In the end, I couldn't pay off my debts, or protect the people I wanted to protect...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I'm a right bastard, through and through.
Leone smacks the stove hard with the tongs, hard enough to cause sparks to fly.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I'd rather die than bow down to those savages at the bank... Just the thought that they'd have the gall to kidnap Benny makes me wanna blow the whole damn place to bits...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Leone...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You said earlier that after I sell my remaining shares, I'll at least be able to leave the house for Benny?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: But you sure did a number on my stove, just to win me over. *cough* *cough*... You weren't kidding when you said you'd do anything.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No... I didn't pour the water in there. I wouldn't go that far.

spans.text: No... I didn't pour the water in there. I wouldn't go

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Wait, if it wasn't you, then who?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Woodrow? What're you doing here?
Woodrow doesn't answer. He simply walks right up to the stove and sets down a heavy-looking box.
Leone walks over and sees a box stuffed haphazardly with charcoal pieces.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Consider it an apology.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Relax, Leone. The toes of your shoes are about to tear the carpet.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Relax? That word has no place here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I've prepared all the promissory documents and transfer contracts, so the bank should have nothing to say. Of course... Benny helped out a lot as well. The process shouldn't take very long, and it'll all go smoothly.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Would you like me to get you some water?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Nah, I'm good. The fact that I can even stand here means I'm already mentally prepared to let it all go.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm really sorry about this...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Just leave me alone for a second.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Now that I can single-handedly release them from those blood-sucking shareholders with the swipe of a pen, I need a moment to myself, so I can say goodbye.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Jessica...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sylvia?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Y-Yes, so here's the deal. I took a sneak peek at the documents you prepared... Mr. Theremin's loan repayment is not within the scope of my job, but...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: There are a number of issues with your reference data... The shares are overvalued, and there are some holes that don't add up in the end.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: You're still short by a considerable amount... I'd appreciate it if you could call him over for me, since there's no way I can face him...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No, we're not going to put that on him right now. I'll make a check out to the bank, so can you keep it a secret for me? Please?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: This much... in one lump sum?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's not that big of a deal. Desperate times.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: But, if Mr. Theremin found out... You know how prideful can be...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Which is why this is just between us. Nobody else needs to know. Please, Sylvia.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: O-Okay then...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Then, can I take another look at your documents?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I only have copies with me.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: That's good enough... Umm... There are still areas that could use some adjustment...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: And then, there's the tax returns...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Look, these are all items that could've been written off... Thirty bucks here, seventy-five there... There's also a rather large deduction here, a full four hundred.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Adding everything up, it comes out to one thousand three hundred and twenty-nine, though that's barely a fraction of the amount you have to make up for...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You discovered all that just by casually thumbing through the documents?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Umm... this looks good enough. Th-Then, I'll directly report this, and say that y-you filed a brand new application...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Finally, that should take care of the weight around Leone's neck... But he's far from the only one.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...I need to pick up the pace before Fort Barron arrives.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Every person I help has to count for something... right?

steps.name: Bank Employee
steps.text: Manager, we can close Leone Theremin's case. He finally decided to sell his shares.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: That obstinate bastard set us back for years.

steps.name: Bank Employee
steps.text: He was also extremely rude when selling them, scolding us with some rather colorful language, and calling us kidnappers and so forth.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: But what can he do other than run his mouth?

steps.name: Bank Employee
steps.text: Well then, how about we pay him a direct visit next time?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: No need to rush. I heard someone advanced the money for him, and now he is indeed debt-free.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: But once his shares are sold, there are plenty others circling the mine, waiting for us to swoop in.
